texts.content:
这组参考图非常有《疯狂的麦克斯》（Mad Max）那种废土、狂热、后现代重金属的视觉张力。结合你的剧本，这个场景极具黑色幽默和狂暴的动作感（非常类似于《狂暴之路》里战争男孩大喊“Witness me/见证我”的桥段）。

由于目前主流的AI视频生成工具（如Sora, Runway Gen-2, Pika, Midjourney配合转视频工具）对英文提示词理解更好，并且分镜头去生成成功率最高，我为你制定了一套**分镜头的视频生成提示词（Prompt）**，你可以逐段放入AI视频工具中生成，最后剪辑在一起。

---

### 🎨 全局视觉风格设定 (Global Style Keywords)
在每次生成时，建议带上这些后缀以保持风格统一：
> `Cinematic lighting, Mad Max Fury Road style, post-apocalyptic wasteland, gritty, heavy sandstorm, dust flying, highly detailed, photorealistic, 8k resolution, dynamic motion blur, extreme speed, unreal engine 5 render --ar 16:9`

---

### 🎬 分镜视频提示词 (Shot-by-Shot Video Prompts)

#### **镜头 1：车队狂飙，鸡小弟出场 (Establishment & Chicken Minion)**
**画面描述：** 在漫天黄沙中，废土车队高速行驶。特写给到开着生锈三轮摩托的鸡小弟，他身体前倾，动作神经质，死死盯着前方。
> **Prompt:** A fast-paced tracking shot of a post-apocalyptic convoy driving at extreme speed through a barren desert, kicking up massive clouds of sand. Focus on a fanatic muscular man with a realistic white rooster head, wearing spiked shoulder pads, driving a rusted three-wheeled wasteland motorcycle. He leans forward aggressively, gripping the handlebars tightly, staring intensely ahead. Shaky camera, high energy, dynamic motion blur.

#### **镜头 2：鹰老大压迫感登场 (Eagle Boss Appears)**
**画面描述：** 镜头平移，一辆厚重的装甲越野车平稳驶来，鹰老大坐在驾驶座上，姿态极其稳如泰山，透着绝对的权威。
> **Prompt:** Low angle tracking shot. A massive, heavily armored rusted grey SUV with metal plating drives smoothly alongside the motorcycle, unaffected by the bumps. Inside the SUV, seen through the broken window, a muscular man with a realistic bald eagle head wearing aviator goggles and a brown leather bomber jacket drives calmly. He sits perfectly straight, radiating extreme authority and stoicism. Stable camera movement.

#### **镜头 3：呼唤老大被无视 (Calling the Boss - Ignored)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟转头看向旁边高大的越野车，肢体激动地大喊（可以表现为频繁转头和单手挥舞）。鹰老大直视前方，毫无反应。
> **Prompt:** Medium shot. The rooster-headed man on the motorcycle turns his head frantically towards the large SUV next to him, waving one hand wildly in the air as if shouting enthusiastically. Cut to the eagle-headed man inside the SUV, keeping his head perfectly still, staring dead straight ahead, completely ignoring the motorcycle. Fast-moving desert background.

#### **镜头 4：老大的注视 (The Glance)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟再次剧烈挥手大喊。这一次，鹰老大微微转动高傲的头颅，透过护目镜向下瞥了他一眼。
> **Prompt:** Over-the-shoulder shot from the motorcycle looking up at the SUV window. The rooster-headed man shakes with excitement. In slow motion, the majestic eagle-headed man slowly and subtly turns his head slightly to the side, looking down through his aviator goggles at the motorcycle driver. Cinematic, dramatic tension.

#### **镜头 5：鸡小弟癫狂 (The Fanatic Frenzy)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟的特写。虽然戴着头套看不见表情，但他整个上半身都在剧烈颤抖，仰天长啸，陷入了极其狂热的癫狂状态（“老大看我了！”）。
> **Prompt:** Extreme close-up of the rooster-headed man on the speeding motorcycle. His body language explodes with manic excitement. He throws his head back, his whole body shaking, one hand punching the air in absolute fanatic delirium. High-speed wind blowing his feathers. Extreme adrenaline, chaotic energy.

#### **镜头 6：拔管、油门到底 (The Sabotage & Full Throttle)**
**画面描述：** 镜头对准摩托车油箱和把手。一只带着废土护腕的脏手猛地拔掉了一根输油管，随后死死将油门拧到最底。
> **Prompt:** Close-up action shot. A dirty, scarred hand wearing spiked leather bracers violently rips a black fuel hose from the exposed engine of the rusted motorcycle. Sparks fly. Immediately, the hand grabs the motorcycle throttle and violently twists it to the absolute maximum. Thick black smoke erupts from the engine.

#### **镜头 7：失控狂飙 (Out of Control & Rocketing Forward)**
**画面描述：** 全景/跟随镜头。三轮摩托车发出爆燃的火光，轮胎疯狂打滑扬起巨量沙尘，整个车身失控般左右摇摆，随后像炮弹一样冲出画面前方。
> **Prompt:** Wide action tracking shot. The rusted three-wheeled motorcycle suddenly accelerates with a massive, explosive burst of speed. The rear tires spin wildly, creating a massive sandstorm. The vehicle loses control, fishtailing violently left and right, before rocketing forward at unimaginable speed, disappearing into the thick dust cloud ahead. Epic post-apocalyptic action scene.

---

### 💡 制作建议 (Tips for Generation)
1. **动物面具的局限：** 因为AI在处理“动物头+人身”时，很难表现微表情（比如“眼神变激动”）。所以在提示词中，我将重点转化为了**肢体语言**（剧烈颤抖、仰天长啸、手部动作）和**镜头语言**（慢动作、镜头抖动）来表达情绪。
2. **车辆连贯性：** 跑视频的时候，如果AI把车变了样子，可以尝试把你的原图垫进去作为**图像参考（Image Prompt）**，特别是生锈越野车和三轮摩托车的原图，能极大提高一致性。
3. **音效非常重要：** 这种废土风格的片子，后期的配音（狂暴的引擎轰鸣、风沙声、鸡小弟癫狂的嘶吼声、金属碰撞声）会占到整体表现力的50%以上。建议生成视频后，配上《疯狂的麦克斯》风格的BGM和重低音效。

这组参考图非常有《疯狂的麦克斯》（Mad Max）那种废土、狂热、后现代重金属的视觉张力。结合你的剧本，这个场景极具黑色幽默和狂暴的动作感（非常类似于《狂暴之路》里战争男孩大喊“Witness me/见证我”的桥段）。

由于目前主流的AI视频生成工具（如Sora, Runway Gen-2, Pika, Midjourney配合转视频工具）对英文提示词理解更好，并且分镜头去生成成功率最高，我为你制定了一套**分镜头的视频生成提示词（Prompt）**，你可以逐段放入AI视频工具中生成，最后剪辑在一起。

---

### 🎨 全局视觉风格设定 (Global Style Keywords)
在每次生成时，建议带上这些后缀以保持风格统一：
> `Cinematic lighting, Mad Max Fury Road style, post-apocalyptic wasteland, gritty, heavy sandstorm, dust flying, highly detailed, photorealistic, 8k resolution, dynamic motion blur, extreme speed, unreal engine 5 render --ar 16:9`

---

### 🎬 分镜视频提示词 (Shot-by-Shot Video Prompts)

#### **镜头 1：车队狂飙，鸡小弟出场 (Establishment & Chicken Minion)**
**画面描述：** 在漫天黄沙中，废土车队高速行驶。特写给到开着生锈三轮摩托的鸡小弟，他身体前倾，动作神经质，死死盯着前方。
> **Prompt:** A fast-paced tracking shot of a post-apocalyptic convoy driving at extreme speed through a barren desert, kicking up massive clouds of sand. Focus on a fanatic muscular man with a realistic white rooster head, wearing spiked shoulder pads, driving a rusted three-wheeled wasteland motorcycle. He leans forward aggressively, gripping the handlebars tightly, staring intensely ahead. Shaky camera, high energy, dynamic motion blur.

#### **镜头 2：鹰老大压迫感登场 (Eagle Boss Appears)**
**画面描述：** 镜头平移，一辆厚重的装甲越野车平稳驶来，鹰老大坐在驾驶座上，姿态极其稳如泰山，透着绝对的权威。
> **Prompt:** Low angle tracking shot. A massive, heavily armored rusted grey SUV with metal plating drives smoothly alongside the motorcycle, unaffected by the bumps. Inside the SUV, seen through the broken window, a muscular man with a realistic bald eagle head wearing aviator goggles and a brown leather bomber jacket drives calmly. He sits perfectly straight, radiating extreme authority and stoicism. Stable camera movement.

#### **镜头 3：呼唤老大被无视 (Calling the Boss - Ignored)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟转头看向旁边高大的越野车，肢体激动地大喊（可以表现为频繁转头和单手挥舞）。鹰老大直视前方，毫无反应。
> **Prompt:** Medium shot. The rooster-headed man on the motorcycle turns his head frantically towards the large SUV next to him, waving one hand wildly in the air as if shouting enthusiastically. Cut to the eagle-headed man inside the SUV, keeping his head perfectly still, staring dead straight ahead, completely ignoring the motorcycle. Fast-moving desert background.

#### **镜头 4：老大的注视 (The Glance)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟再次剧烈挥手大喊。这一次，鹰老大微微转动高傲的头颅，透过护目镜向下瞥了他一眼。

#### **镜头 5：鸡小弟癫狂 (The Fanatic Frenzy)**
**画面描述：** 鸡小弟的特写。虽然戴着头套看不见表情，但他整个上半身都在剧烈颤抖，仰天长啸，陷入了极其狂热的癫狂状态（“老大看我了！”）。

He throws his head back, his whole body shaking, one hand punching the air in absolute fanatic delirium. High-speed wind blowing his feathers. Extreme adrenaline, chaotic energy.

**画面描述：** 镜头对准摩托车油箱和把手。一只带着废土护腕的脏手猛地拔掉了一根输油管，随后死死将油门拧到最底。

1. **动物面具的局限：** 因为AI在处理“动物头+人身”时，很难表现微表情（比如“眼神变激动”）。所以在提示词中，我将重点转化为了**肢体语言**（剧烈颤抖、仰天长啸、手部动作）和**镜头语言**（慢动作、镜头抖动）来表达情绪。
